methodology.sources: Official GitHub REST metadata and pinned codeload archives; official PyPI and Hugging Face registry metadata.
methodology.web_tool: web.run invoked for GitHub searches and pages; returned empty results. Live official HTTPS retrievals supplied verifiable evidence.
methodology.download_metrics: Not collected; stars and forks are popularity context, not production adoption or fitness.
methodology.security_scope: Public per-repository published advisories and selected source/configuration surfaces; not a full transitive vulnerability audit.
methodology.source_release_policy: Default-branch full SHAs are inspection targets; package/release metadata is tracked separately.

claims.statement: LLMLingua uses a gpt-3.5-turbo tokenizer and fixed $0.06/1000 token savings estimate; not current billed cost.
LLMLingua defaults trust_remote_code to True and evaluates the context_budget expression.
MF router calls a remote embedding API and routes using only the last message content.
Calibration generate branch passes routed_pair keyword absent from Controller signature.
LMCache documents retrieved-token overlap with locally computed pages, so retrieved count may exceed newly avoided prefill work.
KV reuse changes prefill computation rather than input text; hosted API discount cannot be inferred from engine counters.
The current mem0 benchmark table is explicitly managed-platform-only and includes proprietary optimizations.
Search top_k caps memory count, not final target-model prompt tokens; caller needs a separate budget selector.
Outlines constraints may reduce invalid-output retries but do not constitute prompt compression or prove a cost reduction.
Public microsoft/TokenCut returned 404 and Microsoft owner-scoped search returned zero results. No claim about private or future repositories.
